responsibility: This file defines gm2’s mapping onto GCC builtin functions and builtin constants. It constructs function prototypes for the subset of builtins usable from Modula-2, registers them in the global scope and builtin tables, records key builtin decl nodes such as alloca, memcpy, huge_val*, and isfinite, and provides helper queries and call builders so later expression/type lowering can reference target-aware builtin semantics through GCC trees.
same_name_distinction: This file performs builtin registration and construction: it defines the builtin prototype table, creates GCC FUNCTION_DECL nodes, inserts selected builtins into global scope, and caches decl nodes such as alloca, memcpy, huge_val*, and isfinite. The .def and .h files only describe how other code can access those facilities.
